major_concerns: Sandbox fidelity may under- or over-estimate real production harms
Verifier rule-set completeness risks systematic false negatives
Pre-registered >30% relative reduction target may be optimistic without power/sample justification
required_design_repairs: Specify verifier tool name/version and exact rule-set; publish rule-set or machine-readable rules
Ensure paired design uses identical generated configs per-intent for baseline vs verifier pipeline (or justify alternative)
Increase diversity of sandbox topologies and intent classes or justify representativeness
Add at least one additional LLM or prompt-variant to test generalizability; precompute power analysis for effect-size target

major_concerns: Sandbox harm labels may be noisy/partial and bias predictive performance
Feature definitions (e.g., change-impact rank) are underspecified
Risk of overfitting on synthetic/limited task bank
Operational thresholds and utility function not fully defined
required_design_repairs: Provide exact, implementable definitions for each metric and code to compute them
Specify label-noise mitigation and estimate label reliability (inter-sandbox agreement)
Pre-register model-selection and hyperparameter ranges and include holdout task-class folds
Define operator utility (costs of false accept/reject) and use in decision-threshold selection

major_concerns: Publication of adversarial templates risks misuse and may force heavy redaction limiting reproducibility
Attacks may overfit to the tested LLM; single-model evaluation undermines general claims
Responsible-disclosure and legal/ethical procedures are only briefly mentioned
required_design_repairs: Define and include a formal redaction/responsible-disclosure policy and provide a reproducibility pathway (e.g., controlled artifact access to reviewers)
Test attacks across multiple LLMs/seeds to assess generality
Provide mitigations' exact implementations and failure modes; quantify utility loss introduced by mitigations
Pre-register ethical approval/oversight and redaction criteria

major_concerns: Token-probability proxies may poorly correlate with semantic correctness in config tasks
Conformal/ensemble methods raise compute and deployment costs; operational trade-offs under-specified
Sample size (150 intents) may be marginal for calibration evaluation across heterogeneous task classes
required_design_repairs: Validate proxy-feature correlation with sandbox harm on pilot data and report results before main run
Clarify exchangeability assumptions for conformal methods and justify them for this domain
Increase intent-bank size or stratify sampling to ensure calibration evaluation per-task-class
Pre-register computational-cost budget and operator-threshold decision policy
